{
  "problem": "Design a minimal REST API for task management.",
  "objectives": [
    "Create an API that allows clients to create, read, update, and delete tasks.",
    "Ensure the API follows RESTful conventions.",
    "Keep the design simple and minimal."
  ],
  "constraints": [
    "The API must be RESTful.",
    "The API should be minimal, focusing only on core task management functionality."
  ],
  "non_goals": [
    "Include authentication or authorization mechanisms.",
    "Implement pagination, filtering, or sorting for task listing.",
    "Support advanced features like task assignments, due dates, or categories unless explicitly required."
  ],
  "open_questions": [
    "What fields should a task object contain? (e.g., id, title, description, status)",
    "What are the specific endpoints required? (e.g., /tasks, /tasks/{id})",
    "What data format should be used for request/response? (assumed JSON)",
    "Should there be any specific status codes or error handling patterns?",
    "Is there a preferred naming convention for endpoints?",
    "Should tasks be stored in-memory, or is a database expected?"
  ],
  "raw_prompt": "Diseña una API REST minimal para gestionar tareas. Responde con estructura JSON."
}
